training_scope.strict_blocker: The reviewed-lineage bank is not 34-class complete; unresolved-lineage sources must not be promoted merely to make the experiment complete.

pretrained_prototype_with_existing_appea.finding: ImageNet embedding plus class prototypes does not separate the new-render M2 from neighboring Wan classes.

frozen_backbone_balanced_linear_head.finding: A learned linear Mahjong head improves some boundaries but does not recover M2; the result is stable across five seeds.

pretrained_last_projection_plus_linear_h.finding: Adapting the final pretrained feature projection does not improve M2 and introduces additional regressions.

wan_red_glyph_anchor.finding: Using the shared red Wan glyph as a geometry anchor is not sufficient; edge-only matching destabilizes other Wan identities.

reviewed_m2_source_recrop.stored_bbox_observation: The reviewed exact bbox is visibly tight/off-center relative to the full tile in source frame 0.
reviewed_m2_source_recrop.finding: The stored M2 crop should be treated as a data-quality concern, but recropping it alone does not solve the observed cross-render confusion.

decision.next_priority: Obtain or recover a genuinely independent M2 source from the newer rendering domain, then re-run source-grouped template and learned-representation A/B. If source-diverse M2 remains confused, evaluate a stronger pretrained visual representation before any Runtime replacement.
